reserveReview.rationale: Pinned reads at Rootstock block 9077990 (2026-07-22T01:16:43Z) identify the official V3 bucket contracts and fully value both positive collateral balances. The RIF bucket reported 308,770,106.853842843323055890 RIF and an on-chain RIF/USD price of 0.072568951680133500, or $22,407,122.96454618. The DOC bucket reported 67.486329105 DOC at an on-chain $1.00 price, or $67.486329105. Normalizing the $22,407,190.450875285 total produces the recorded 99.9996988184% RIF and 0.0003011816% DOC weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official V3 deployment identities and pinned bucket nACcb balances normalized by each bucket's on-chain USDRIF collateral price at Rootstock block 9077990
